item.content:encoded:
I'd like to share **pve-cli** (`pc`), an open-source command-line client for Proxmox VE — and Proxmox Datacenter Manager (PDM) — that I've been building and testing against live 9.x clusters.

The idea is "remote-first": you run `pc <resource> <action>` and the tool resolves which node hosts the guest for you (via `/cluster/resources`), so you rarely have to think about which node you're on.
